commission.source_quote: The Platform shall retain a commission of thirty percent (30%) of the Net Order Value, being the amount charged to the customer less any promotional discount and less shipping charges.

delivery_fee.source_quote: A delivery fee of Rs. 45.00 per confirmed delivery is payable to the assigned delivery partner.

hold.source_quote: The Seller's share shall become payable only upon confirmation of delivery, and shall be settled no earlier than forty-eight (48) hours thereafter.

promotion_funding.source_quote: Discounts under Platform-run campaigns shall be funded 100% by the Platform.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: Where a customer refund is issued, the Seller payout for that order shall first be reversed. Commission retained by the Platform is refundable on a pro-rata basis.

tax.source_quote: The Platform shall withhold tax at source at one percent (1%) of the commission amount.
